edges.reason: setDelay requires msg.sender to be the Timelock contract itself.
acceptAdmin requires msg.sender to equal pendingAdmin.
setPendingAdmin authorization branch depends on msg.sender.
queueTransaction requires msg.sender to be admin.
cancelTransaction requires msg.sender to be admin.
executeTransaction requires msg.sender to be admin.
getBlockTimestamp returns block.timestamp directly.
queueTransaction compares eta with block.timestamp plus delay.
executeTransaction validates eta and staleness against block.timestamp.
delay state variable is read when validating eta.
GRACE_PERIOD bounds the staleness check in executeTransaction.
queuedTransactions flag is read to authorize execution before the external call.
SafeMath.add is used for delay arithmetic in queueTransaction.
SafeMath.add is used for GRACE_PERIOD arithmetic in executeTransaction.
executeTransaction invokes the low-level call on the attacker-influenced target.
target parameter supplies the destination of the low-level call.
value parameter is forwarded with the low-level call.
callData local is the payload of the low-level call.
The external target call can re-enter executeTransaction before state finalization.
constructor parameter admin_ is assigned to admin.
constructor parameter delay_ is assigned to delay.
setDelay parameter delay_ is written into the delay state variable.
setPendingAdmin parameter pendingAdmin_ is written into pendingAdmin.
target parameter is hashed into txHash.
value parameter is hashed into txHash.
signature parameter is hashed into txHash.
data parameter is hashed into txHash.
eta parameter is hashed into txHash.
target parameter is hashed into the cancelled tx hash.
value parameter is hashed into the cancelled tx hash.
signature parameter is hashed into the cancelled tx hash.
data parameter is hashed into the cancelled tx hash.
eta parameter is hashed into the cancelled tx hash.
target parameter is hashed and used as the call destination.
value parameter is hashed and forwarded to the call.
signature parameter determines the encoded calldata.
data parameter is appended to the encoded calldata.
eta parameter is used in the timelock and staleness checks.
txHash local is computed and returned by queueTransaction.
txHash local is used to clear the queued flag.
txHash local is used to look up the queued transaction.
callData local is assembled from signature and data.
success flag from the low-level call is required.
returnData from the low-level call is returned to the caller.
queueTransaction sets queuedTransactions[txHash] to true.
cancelTransaction sets queuedTransactions[txHash] to false.
executeTransaction clears queuedTransactions[txHash] before the external call.
acceptAdmin transfers admin rights to msg.sender.
acceptAdmin resets pendingAdmin to address(0).
setPendingAdmin writes the new pendingAdmin address.
setDelay writes the new delay value.
constructor initializes admin.
constructor initializes delay.
constructor sets admin_initialized to false.
First setPendingAdmin call is gated on msg.sender equalling admin.
admin_initialized selects which authorization branch setPendingAdmin takes.
queueTransaction compares msg.sender against the stored admin.
cancelTransaction compares msg.sender against the stored admin.
executeTransaction compares msg.sender against the stored admin.
MINIMUM_DELAY bounds the constructor delay parameter.
MAXIMUM_DELAY bounds the constructor delay parameter.
MINIMUM_DELAY bounds the new delay in setDelay.
MAXIMUM_DELAY bounds the new delay in setDelay.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter admin_ is only used to initialize the constructor's state assignment.
Constructor parameter delay_ is only used for the constructor's delay checks and assignment.
setDelay parameter delay_ is only used inside setDelay to update the delay state variable.
setPendingAdmin parameter pendingAdmin_ is only used inside setPendingAdmin to update pendingAdmin.
queueTransaction target parameter is consumed by queueTransaction when building txHash.
queueTransaction value parameter is consumed by queueTransaction when building txHash.
queueTransaction signature parameter is consumed by queueTransaction when building txHash.
queueTransaction data parameter is consumed by queueTransaction when building txHash.
queueTransaction eta parameter is consumed by queueTransaction for hashing and delay validation.
cancelTransaction target parameter is consumed by cancelTransaction when building txHash.
cancelTransaction value parameter is consumed by cancelTransaction when building txHash.
cancelTransaction signature parameter is consumed by cancelTransaction when building txHash.
cancelTransaction data parameter is consumed by cancelTransaction when building txHash.
cancelTransaction eta parameter is consumed by cancelTransaction when building txHash.
executeTransaction target parameter is consumed by executeTransaction and feeds the low-level call.
executeTransaction value parameter is consumed by executeTransaction and forwarded in the call.
executeTransaction signature parameter is consumed by executeTransaction to build callData.
executeTransaction data parameter is consumed by executeTransaction to build callData.
executeTransaction eta parameter is consumed by executeTransaction for timelock and staleness checks.
txHash local exists only within queueTransaction to identify the queued transaction.
txHash local exists only within cancelTransaction to identify the cancelled transaction.
txHash local exists only within executeTransaction to identify the executed transaction.
callData local is constructed solely to be passed into the unsafe low-level call.
success local only holds the low-level call result checked by executeTransaction.
returnData local only carries the low-level call result back out of executeTransaction.
